title: Shopping for clothes in English: phrases, conversation, speaking | English Routine
description:
Shopping for clothes — شرا هدوم
A full lesson for everyday American English, with Arabic help: 8 words and phrases, a real conversation, 3 listening questions, then your turn to speak.
درس كامل: ٨ كلمات بمعناها بالعربي، الحوار، ٣ أسئلة، وبعدين دورك تتكلم بصوتك.

Chapters
0:00 8 words
0:42 The conversation
1:14 3 questions
1:40 Your turn: speak

Words
• try on = يقيس (هدوم)
• fitting room = البروفة
• fit = مقاسه مظبوط
• a size bigger = مقاس أكبر
• on sale = عليه تخفيض
• how much is it? = بكام ده؟
• refund = استرجاع الفلوس
• just looking = بتفرج بس
